question: Which direct input-read primitive and data-flow consume the already-bounded F02 DATA2 variable-prefix region, independent of any physical mutation-oracle outcome or semantic label?
preferred_static_scope: direct sequential input cursor/read primitives reachable from the existing CSMC consumer route
offset_binding_rule: Report a payload-relative offset/range only if it is derived from instruction-level cursor/data-flow evidence. Do not infer offsets from nearby strings, RTTI, field names, or post-oracle outcome patterns.
consumer_name_rule: A semantic-looking class or field label is not sufficient. The read primitive and destination/data-flow must be connected before the label can support a claim.

confidence.CONFIRMED: Direct executable read/field edge with width/endian/count-or-length and destination/data-flow, provenance-bound and not contradicted.
confidence.STRONG: Multiple connected direct edges plus independent controlled evidence, with no missing bridge on the claimed relation.
confidence.CANDIDATE: String/RTTI proximity or one unbound indirect xref only.
confidence.UNRESOLVED: No direct field-read bridge found within the bounded search.
